title: Design Taste agent skill suite
synopsis: A set of 24 Markdown agent skills: one design core, ten visual genre packs, and thirteen craft/code skills. The files contain typography, palette, composition, motion, accessibility, review, and performance guidance; examples and install/validation scripts are separate repository resources.
proposed_creative_branch: Use one core skill and one visual genre for a controlled redesign of the same brief, then assess it with the accessibility and design-review skills. Avoid loading all genre packs together.

script_side_effects.finding: The default installer creates the Claude skills directory and copies every skill into several existing global agent skills directories; copied files can overwrite matching files. An explicit destination argument changes its target.
The screenshot capture helper fetches remote fonts/CDN resources, writes cached/offline files, and uses browser screenshots; it was not run.

verification_scope: Static acquisition and byte integrity only; no subject code, package install, design tool, MCP server, rendered UI, or quality claim was exercised.
